documentation.content: abuseSpikeWatch (hourly) detected a moderation anomaly: either ONE author flooded held content (tag abuse_spike_author) or a GLOBAL surge of auto-held posts (tag abuse_spike_global). Likely a spammer, a targeted-harassment burst, or a coordinated campaign. Open the pending/flagged queues in admin.html; the log entry names the authorId and the count. Tune AUTHOR_THRESHOLD / GLOBAL_THRESHOLD in functions/index.js if noisy.
